description.value: Cafe Orso is a European-style cafe on Gallant Avenue in North Vancouver, offering both indoor and outdoor seating. Its location puts it within reach of cyclists using the nearby Seymour River and Lynn Valley trail networks. No independent web presence could be verified at the time of this record, as the registered domain has been repurposed by a third party.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (1 space) at 8m; stands (1 space) at 44m; stands (6 spaces) at 80m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://www.cafeorso.net/ has been hijacked and now hosts an unrelated Indonesian online gambling platform ('AFTERWIN88'), rendering all website-derived evidence unusable; every amenity field defaults to null. OSM tags provide the only usable evidence: amenity=cafe, cuisine=european, indoor_seating=yes, outdoor_seating=yes, with a North Vancouver address and phone number. Because the domain no longer belongs to Cafe Orso, contact fields cannot be confirmed via website, and the listing requires human review before publication.
concerns: Domain hijacking: https://www.cafeorso.net/ now resolves to 'AFTERWIN88', an Indonesian online gambling/casino platform entirely unrelated to Cafe Orso. The cafe's website content is completely unavailable.
No cycling-relevant amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) can be confirmed; all are null due to the non-functional website.
Phone number and address cannot be cross-checked against the website; contact_confirmed fields are null or false accordingly.

A human reviewer should confirm the business's current status before inclusion.
